items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I did see Grandpa Louis once.

ctx.x: Were your grandparents alive when you were a young boy? Did you have many recollections of them?

Hardly any. I did see Grandpa Louis once. I was not allowed to go to his funeral. I was probably five. I remember my cousin and I just sitting alone in our house. The funeral was next door in the Presbyterian church in Concord.
You were seen as too young to go the funeral, because you were five years old. I can see that.
